The new fallback locales are loaded only by `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, which is invoked solely from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any server-side translation outside that controller path (background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, `I18n.with_locale` blocks, or errors before the filter) will not have the fallback locale YAML loaded, so missing keys may not actually fall back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `:en`."

If the default locale changes and `I18n.reload!` is not called, cached missing-key translations will continue to return the old fallback language. Include the fallback chain/default locale in the cache key or ensure invalidation on fallback changes."
    },

Normal fallback customization such as `I18n.fallbacks[:zh_TW] = [:zh_CN, :en]` will silently have no effect. If fallbacks are intended to be extensible, the class should merge stored/custom entries or expose an explicit extension point."

findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: The accelerator loads translation data lazily, and `translate` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`. The new fallback locales are loaded only by `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, which is invoked solely from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any server-side translation outside that controller path (background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, `I18n.with_locale` blocks, or errors before the filter) will not have the fallback locale YAML loaded, so missing keys may not actually fall back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `:en`.

findings.title: Translation cache key omits fallback order/default locale
findings.body: After this change, the result of a cached translation can depend on `SiteSetting.default_locale` (and the hardcoded `:en` fallback), but the cache key is only key + current locale + backend object id. If the default locale changes and `I18n.reload!` is not called, cached missing-key translations will continue to return the old fallback language. Include the fallback chain/default locale in the cache key or ensure invalidation on fallback changes.

findings.title: Unconditional call to custom `ensure_loaded!` can raise
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` assumes the fallbacks object is the custom `FallbackLocaleList`. If another initializer, plugin, or test replaces `I18n.fallbacks` with a standard fallback object, every request will raise NoMethodError. Consider calling it only when `I18n.fallbacks.respond_to?(:ensure_loaded!)`.

findings.title: Fallback list ignores hash storage and assignments
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList` subclasses Hash but overrides `[]` to always recompute the chain and never consult stored entries. Normal fallback customization such as `I18n.fallbacks[:zh_TW] = [:zh_CN, :en]` will silently have no effect. If fallbacks are intended to be extensible, the class should merge stored/custom entries or expose an explicit extension point.

findings.title: Unsynchronized initialization/read of @loaded_locales
findings.body: `ensure_loaded!` initializes and checks `@loaded_locales` outside `LOAD_MUTEX`, while `load_locale` mutates the same array inside the mutex. Under multithreaded servers this can race, causing duplicate loads or lost/cleared loaded-locale state. Initialize the array in a thread-safe way and perform the check under the same mutex.
